surface_mechanism_description: Ligand exchange between TMA and surface hydroxyl groups followed by water pulse to regenerate OH sites
evidence: The self-cleaning effect of TMA was first reported by Ye et al. High resolution transmission electron microscopy (HTEM) and medium energy ion scattering (MEIS) showed thinning of the native oxide from the GaAs surface by Al2O3 ALD with TMA and H2O. The self-cleaning effect has also been reported for the TMA-treated InGaAs. Later, computational modeling of possible native oxide removal mechanisms predicted that the reaction mostly produces As4 gas, but also GaAs solid or InAs solid.
